answer: Reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life, requiring sustained, verifiable honest service to maintain influence; brief activity fades instead of accumulating indefinitely. In an EigenTrust-style matrix, a newly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality without credible reciprocal endorsements. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits borrowed trust, keeping such identities below consensus thresholds. A sybil spiral cannot turn a thin thread of collusion into a lasting relic of legitimacy.
